Ideas are welcome and discussed before code is written.
For a whole new module, see the "Adding a New Module" section of CONTRIBUTING.md.

### Summary

<!-- What would you like the repository to be able to do that it cannot today? -->

### Module

<!-- Which module does this affect? "New module" if it is a new one. -->

### Problem

<!-- What is the real-world situation that makes you want this? Concrete scenarios beat abstract
     requests. What breaks today, or what takes too long? -->

### Proposed solution

<!-- What you have in mind. If you have several options, list them with the trade-offs of each. -->

### Alternatives considered

<!-- What else could solve this, and why is your proposal better? -->

### Platform

<!-- [ ] Bash  [ ] PowerShell  [ ] Python  [ ] Go  [ ] Documentation / CI only -->

### Scope estimate

<!-- Your best guess at the size of the work, in rough terms. If you are unsure, say so — it is
     fine, and it helps to know. -->

### Additional context

<!-- Links, references, real-world examples. -->
